newsitem.title: GREECE: GERMAN RETURNS MARBLE STONE FROM PARTHENON.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN RETURNS MARBLE STONE FROM PARTHENON.

text.p: A anonymous German citizen returned after many years a marble stone he had taken from the 5th century B.C. Parthenon, Athens' landmark monument, the culture ministry said on Friday.
A ministry statement said the Greek ambassador in Bonn received a package with the marble stone and a letter from the anonymous German.

"This stone belongs to Greece. Many years ago I took it from the Acropolis and now I return it. Because of my age I will not travel to Athens anymore so I would like to ask you to place it again near the Parthenon," the letter said.
The statement said the marble stone would be sent to Athens in a diplomatic bag and that the embassy would send a letter to the German press thanking the anonymous sender.
